```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),      # tail current
    "I2":    (10e-6, 4e-6, 14e-6),    # CS stage current
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 22),            # diff pair
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmidp": (10, 6, 14),             # PMOS mirror + CS (shared -> low offset)
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),        # NMOS bias mirrors
    "Av1":   (7, 3, 15),              # stage-1 gain set by R
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)

    # current budget: stay within 90% of 39 uW
    I1, I2 = p["I1"], p["I2"]
    avail = 0.9 * 39e-6 / vdd - iref
    if I1 + I2 > avail:
        s = max(avail, 2e-6) / (I1 + I2)
        I1, I2 = I1 * s, I2 * s

    gmidn_b = 10.0
    # bias mirror (all NMOS: same gm/Id and L, scaled current)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn_b, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidn_b, p["Ln"], I1, vds=0.3)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmidn_b, p["Ln"], I2, vds=0.7)

    # stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1 / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1 / 2, vds=0.9)
    # stage 2: PMOS CS (same gm/Id, L as m3 -> current = I2 at balance)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # gain-limiting resistor between o1 and the diode node
    rout1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Rt = p["Av1"] / m1.gm
    if Rt >= rout1:
        Rt = 0.9 * rout1
    R = 1.0 / max(1.0 / Rt - 1.0 / rout1, 1e-9)
    Av1 = m1.gm * (1.0 / (1.0 / R + 1.0 / rout1))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: vinn on diode side, vinp on o1 side
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.R("R1", "o1", "d1", R)
    # stage 2
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # two-inverter buffer (non-inverting overall)
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.5, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 4.5, 0.15)

    # delay model
    C1 = m5.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 1e-15
    t1 = 0.69 * Av1 * C1 / m1.gm
    dv1 = min(Av1 * vod, 0.15)
    i2 = min(m5.gm * dv1, I2)
    cin_inv1 = (0.5 + 1.5) * 0.15 * 8.5e-15 + 2.0 * 0.4e-15
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + cin_inv1
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / max(i2, 1e-9)
    cin_inv2 = (1.5 + 4.5) * 0.15 * 8.5e-15 + 6.0 * 0.4e-15
    t3 = 0.69 * (cin_inv2 / 2.5e-4 + cl / 6.0e-4) * vdd + 50e-12
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + I1 + I2)
    Av2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "offset": 0.05 * I2 / m5.gm / Av1,
               "gain_db": db(Av1 * Av2)}
```
